slides.texte_overlay:
Friendship lessons most
men realise far too late
A group chat is not a friendship. Memes keep you in touch, but only real time together keeps you close. Book the dinner, not just the reply.
Your friends need to hear that you value them. "I'm glad we're still friends after all these years." Men rarely say it, and it matters more than you'd think.
Distance doesn't end friendships, neglect does. A friend who moved abroad can stay close with a monthly call. A friend down the road can drift away in silence.
Asking for help brings you closer. Help with a move, advice on a breakup. Letting a friend help you is a gift to the friendship, not a weakness.
Before: our nights out were always the same. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and new stories that bring fresh life to every catch-up.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our nights out were always the same. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. New stories bring life to every catch-up.

slides.texte_overlay: Not every friendship has to last forever. Some friends are for a season. Let them go with gratitude instead of guilt, and make room for new ones.
Showing up for the boring things counts. A hospital waiting room, a quiet birthday, a long drive. The best friends are there when it isn't fun.
